name: site.goat-lighthouse/market-news
title: Market News API
description: AI-scored crypto, equities, forex, commodities & macro news, $0.10 cross-market batch, and Binance announcements via x402 USDC on Base/Solana (15 MCP tools; free catalogue & quotes).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.freeTools: market_catalogue, news_sample, list_supported_coins, check_pass, and unpaid x402 quotes are free.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: Pay per call inside MCP via x402 USDC on Base or Solana: single feeds $0.005-$0.05, cross-market signal batch (get_market_signal_batch) $0.10, annual Binance announcements $0.25, unlimited fair-use passes $3/week or $9/month.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.transportNote: POST Streamable HTTP transport; a zero-dependency Python stdio bridge (mcp_stdio_bridge.py) is included in the repository for stdio-only clients.
